dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Hello, what can I help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you selling?

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Well, take your pick of these wares. But let me tell you first that if you pay with Mora, you'll be up against prices somewhat higher than what you'd pay in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: As you can see, you can purchase food and spices here.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Aaru Village's soil is not well suited for growing anything, so the lion's share of our goods are imported.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: But waiting for others to source goods felt like too passive an approach, so I set this store up.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: In any case, I'll be forward with you — I've nothing to hide in any case — and say that the prices here will be higher than what you'd get in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: It's just how things are... This is as low as I can go when you factor in the costs for one-way shipping.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: That said, you don't have to pay me in Mora. If you've brought something to barter, I'll hear your offer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't have anything at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it. Come back next time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's a pretty good idea, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: I mean, this is a small place. We've got to stick by each other, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Some villagers bring items they no longer use and leave them here with me so that those in need can take them home.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: In fact, this also helps my business. After all, few people will pass a shop without taking a look at the goods, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shipping costs?

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: That's right. I mean, just look around you. There's nothing but sand over here. There isn't anything I can ship to the city to sell, so I can't really make a profit with that.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I once encountered a sandstorm while I was bringing in my goods. In the depths of the desert, I met some folks who looked like researchers.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: They shared some food with me and told me how to return to Aaru Village. However, they refused to reveal their identities.

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Should I try venturing into the desert again and look for those people? I heard that researchers are quite wealthy, so it would be nice if I could earn their Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: That way, I could bring my prices down, and the people in the village would be able to live better lives.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Thanks for going easy on me. If you'd like, we can play again!

dialogues.speaker: Azalai
dialogues.text: Such skill! I didn't think that someone this good would visit our village without any fanfare!
